## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and related issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explain checks not run or failures that remain. Include a minimal synthetic reproducer for matching changes and screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility, manifest/report changes, privacy or packaging implications when relevant. Remove this section if there are none.
- [ ] The change stays within scope and includes meaningful regression coverage where needed.
- [ ] Shared fixtures and attachments contain no private documents, personal information or secrets, and have appropriate licenses/notices.
- [ ] User-facing changes are described in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased where applicable.
